formula_policy.validation: Parse expression AST and validate every reference against granted workbook regions; do not rely on string blacklist. Recalculate and compare supported formulas with independent oracles.

business_checks: Operation must be enabled for this product release and entitlement.
Output format and target kind must match the operation.
Every target resolves against immutable input/template version; targets outside selected range are denied.
create_slide table/chart layouts require matching table_data/chart_data; row/series dimensions must match.
Only selected or generated image IDs may be used; no arbitrary URLs or paths.
Word replace_image requires a uniquely identified supported image; ambiguous or complex objects are denied.
Basic PPT generation supports 1-30 slides; product PPT workflow supports 5-30 slides.
Total written nonempty cells per job must not exceed 100000 and per-output limits apply.
Generated source IDs must exist and support key numbers; missing fields remain visibly unfilled.
PPT patch cannot mutate shared master/theme/media for unselected slides.
